points.reached by: bus_req_i ==> bus_access carries bus_req_i.data into the transmit-data path.
points.reason: The bus write data is copied toward the transmit FIFO, while the same bus-access control can configure the FIFO-clear condition that discards pending data.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> tx_fifo.wdata carries bus_req_i.data.
points.reason: This point is only an unchanged wiring path into the FIFO and does not itself expose, alter, or block the byte.

points.reached by: tx_fifo.wdata ==> tx_engine_fifo_inst carries the byte into the FIFO, and the FIFO returns tx_fifo.rdata.
points.reason: The black-box FIFO stores the bus-written byte and returns it on rdata; its clear and read controls can discard or withhold the byte.

points.reached by: tx_engine_fifo_inst ==> transmitter carries tx_fifo.rdata into the transmit engine.
points.reason: The transmit engine loads the FIFO byte into its shift register and drives the transmit bit, while CTS and the hardware-flow-control setting can hold or release transmission.

points.reached by: uart_rxd_i ==> receiver carries sampled receive data into the receiver.
points.reason: The receiver samples uart_rxd_i and shifts it into the receive byte, which is then written into the receive FIFO; receiver completion can therefore change the received byte or its delivery.

points.reached by: receiver ==> rx_fifo.wdata carries rx_engine.sreg into the receive FIFO.
points.reason: This point only forwards the assembled receive byte to the FIFO.

points.reached by: rx_fifo.wdata ==> rx_engine_fifo_inst carries the received byte into the FIFO, and the FIFO returns rx_fifo.rdata.
points.reason: The black-box FIFO retains received bytes and returns them on rdata; its clear and read controls can discard or prevent delivery of a byte.

points.reached by: rx_engine_fifo_inst ==> bus_access carries rx_fifo.rdata into the bus response path.
points.reason: A bus read exposes rx_fifo.rdata in bus_rsp_o.data, while the receive FIFO can be cleared or its read can be withheld.

points.reached by: bus_req_i ==> bus_access carries the enable setting from bus_req_i.data.
points.reason: A bus write changes ctrl.enable, and clearing it disables the clock-enable output, clears FIFOs, and disables the receiver and transmitter.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> clkgen_en_o carries ctrl.enable through the concurrent assignment.
points.reason: The output directly returns ctrl.enable, so changing or withholding this output changes the operational-enable setting and can disable UART operation.

points.reached by: bus_req_i ==> bus_access carries the prescaler and baud settings from bus_req_i.data.
points.reason: Bus writes replace ctrl.prsc and ctrl.baud, which select the UART clock and reload the transmit and receive timing counters.

points.reached by: bus_access --> uart_clk is decided by ctrl.prsc.
points.reason: The prescaler selects the clock bit used to pace UART state machines, so an incorrect selection can mis-time or halt serial operation.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> transmitter carries ctrl.baud into the transmit timing logic.
points.reason: The transmitter reloads its baud counter from ctrl.baud, so changing the setting changes bit timing and can prevent correct transmission.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> receiver carries ctrl.baud into the receive timing logic.
points.reason: The receiver reloads its sampling counter from ctrl.baud, so changing the setting can mis-time or prevent reception.

points.reached by: bus_req_i ==> bus_access carries the hardware-flow-control setting from bus_req_i.data.
points.reason: A bus write changes ctrl.hwfc_en, which changes CTS gating in the transmitter and the RTS decision in the receive flow-control process.

points.reached by: bus_access --> transmitter carries ctrl.hwfc_en as a condition of transmit progress.
points.reason: The setting selects whether CTS can hold the transmitter, so changing it can release or block transmission incorrectly.

points.reached by: bus_access --> rtr_control carries ctrl.hwfc_en as a condition of RTS generation.
points.reason: The setting selects whether the RTS output follows receive-flow-control conditions or is forced inactive.

points.reached by: uart_ctsn_i ==> transmitter carries the sampled CTS status into the transmit-state decision.
points.reason: The CTS input is sampled into tx_engine.cts and controls whether the transmitter advances, so changing it can release or indefinitely block transmission.

points.reached by: The held lines in rtr_control produce the receive-flow-control output.
points.reason: The process assigns uart_rtsn_o from enable, hardware-flow-control enable, and receive FIFO occupancy; altering the assignment can falsely permit or block incoming data.

points.reached by: rx_engine_fifo_inst --> rtr_control carries rx_fifo.half as a receive-flow-control decision input.
points.reason: The FIFO half-full status decides whether RTS is asserted and can therefore change whether the peer sends data.

points.reached by: bus_access --> rtr_control carries ctrl.enable and ctrl.hwfc_en as output-decision inputs.
points.reason: The stored enable and hardware-flow-control settings select whether RTS is active or forced inactive.

points.reached by: The held lines in rx_irq_generator produce irq_rx_o from receive status and interrupt enables.
points.reason: The process combines receive FIFO status with receive interrupt-enable settings, so those inputs can generate a false or missing interrupt.

points.reached by: rx_engine_fifo_inst ==> rx_irq_generator carries rx_fifo.avail, rx_fifo.free, and rx_fifo.half.
points.reason: The FIFO status outputs directly select the receive interrupt condition.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> rx_irq_generator carries ctrl.enable and the receive interrupt-enable settings.
points.reason: Bus-writable interrupt-enable fields and ctrl.enable determine whether receive conditions assert irq_rx_o.

points.reached by: The held lines in tx_irq_generator produce irq_tx_o from transmit status and interrupt enables.
points.reason: The process combines transmit FIFO status with transmit interrupt-enable settings, so those inputs can generate a false or missing interrupt.

points.reached by: tx_engine_fifo_inst ==> tx_irq_generator carries tx_fifo.avail and tx_fifo.half.
points.reason: The FIFO status outputs directly select the transmit interrupt condition.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> tx_irq_generator carries ctrl.enable and the transmit interrupt-enable settings.
points.reason: Bus-writable transmit interrupt-enable fields and ctrl.enable determine whether irq_tx_o asserts.

points.reached by: The held lines in fifo_overrun store rx_engine.over when a receive write meets a full FIFO.
points.reason: The overrun flag is cleared when disabled and set when rx_fifo.we is asserted while rx_fifo.free is low, so its status can be changed or suppressed.

points.reached by: fifo_overrun ==> bus_access carries rx_engine.over into bus_rsp_o.data.
points.reason: This point only copies the overrun status into the designed bus read-back path and does not itself change the stored status.
